people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
translations.bsb: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
translations.kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will ➔ God bring with him.
translations.asv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also that are fallen asleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
